cards.lore: A 1910 document that systematically replaced diverse healing traditions with petrochemical pipelines.
cards.power: Eliminate one non-corporate player from the board.

cards.lore: Rockefeller grants ensuring only the academies teaching the pill-pushing curriculum survive the winter.
cards.power: Pay 5 coins to rewrite the rulebook in your favor.

cards.lore: Standardised, rigorously sterile, and perfectly calibrated to prescribe the funder's products.
cards.power: Convert 3 organic resources into 1 synthetic, patentable asset.

cards.lore: No corporate grant, no state license. The botanical traditions fade to black.
cards.power: Target loses all active nature-based healing buffs.

cards.lore: A catastrophic strategic error for any pharmaceutical portfolio. The cured patient does not return.
cards.power: Target player discards their hand and stops paying you rent.

cards.lore: The holy grail: daily medication, indefinitely, with cascading side effects requiring further medication.
cards.power: Generate 1 coin every turn for the rest of the game.

cards.lore: Lowering the threshold of healthy until the entire population requires a daily pill.
cards.power: Move the goalposts. Target player must re-roll healthy stats until they trigger a condition.

cards.lore: Eleven experts defining the disease, who just happen to be funded by the manufacturer of the cure.
cards.power: Hide 3 cards face-down; opponents cannot read them until they trigger.

cards.lore: Deformed 10,000 children, but taught the industry how to survive a regulatory crisis.
cards.power: Play to automatically win a round, but permanently reduce your max health by half.

cards.lore: Designing the safety test protocol so it literally cannot find the danger you are looking for.
cards.power: Nullify an opponent's attack by proving it didn't hurt a cockroach.

cards.lore: The one FDA eagle who actually looked at the data and said No to the tidal wave.
cards.power: Block any corporate action this turn. (Cannot be countered).

cards.lore: Industry-funded studies miraculously find their own drugs vastly safer than independent studies do.
cards.power: Declare your own dice roll is a 6. Nobody is allowed to check.

cards.lore: 500,000 dead, billions in profit, and the foundational liability successfully dodged.
cards.power: Drain 1 health from all players per turn to build your wealth.

cards.lore: A brilliant, lethal marketing campaign disguised as compassionate pain management.
cards.power: Hypnotize target player into discarding their entire hand to buy a painkiller.

cards.lore: A grassroots patient movement entirely astroturfed by a pharmaceutical PR firm.
cards.power: Steal a sympathy token from another player while wearing a fuzzy disguise.

cards.lore: Pay a billion in fines, keep ten billion in profits, admit absolutely no wrongdoing.
cards.power: Escape game-over by paying exactly 10% of your total hoarded gold.

cards.lore: Over 88,000 heart attacks, but the sheer mathematics of the profit outweighed the settlement cost.
cards.power: Deal massive damage to your opponent, but roll a D6. On a 1, your own avatar explodes.

cards.lore: The internal memo you were never supposed to see. A known risk, a known outcome, a known decision.
cards.power: Profits > Corpses. OK.

cards.lore: A simplified marketing narrative that became medical dogma without the burden of established science.
cards.power: Create a phantom buff. It does nothing mathematically, but opponents must respect it.

cards.lore: Repeating a simplified biological lie until the practitioners believe it's complex truth.
cards.power: Change the name and text of any card in play to suit your current narrative needs.

cards.lore: Decades of failed safety checks bypassed in a single night by an emergency slingshot.
cards.power: Play a card instantly, ignoring all resource costs and mandatory safety checks.

cards.lore: Smashing the red tape glass to unleash a highly profitable planetary experiment.
cards.power: Shatter all ongoing defensive spells and regulatory shields on the board.

cards.lore: Releasing the clinical trial safety data only after everyone who took the product is dead.
cards.power: Delay the effects of an opponent's successful attack against you for 75 turns.

cards.lore: The institutional habit of looking the other way while the control group catches fire.
cards.power: Ignore all damage taken this turn by aggressively pretending it didn't happen.

cards.lore: Moving between public defense and private profit with extraordinary, legal grace.
cards.power: Swap your faction affiliation mid-turn to avoid any regulatory penalty.

cards.lore: The regulator's operational budget depends entirely on approving the client's products quickly.
cards.power: Insert a coin to automatically force a Yes from the Game Master.

cards.lore: Independent experts making crucial decisions while wearing collars paid for by the industry.
cards.power: Vote to change a rule; your vote counts 10x if you hold the most gold.

cards.lore: Steering global health priorities with massive, untraceable strings of private foundation cash.
cards.power: Pay 5 coins to privately dictate the next event card drawn from the deck.

cards.lore: He saw too much through the microscope, so they burned his laboratory to the ground.
cards.power: Reveal the top 3 cards of the deck, but you must lose your next turn.

cards.lore: The establishment's absolute favorite tool for peer-reviewing disruptive medical inventions.
cards.power: Destroy one unpatented item on the board permanently.

cards.lore: Proved clinical nutrition fights cancer; got stripped of his medical license for the insult.
cards.power: Heal fully using organic resources, but become a target for all Corporate players.

cards.lore: If you can't put a corporate barcode on it, it is scientifically and legally worthless.
cards.power: Costs 0 to play, provides immense healing, but cannot be monetized or traded.

cards.lore: A pasture weed formula that triggered over one hundred federal lawsuits to suppress.
cards.power: Evade capture for 3 turns while passively healing your allies.

cards.lore: Smuggling botanical efficacy past the heavily armed borders of medical orthodoxy.
cards.power: Move one banned item across the board secretly without triggering traps.

cards.lore: A Nobel-winning, hyper-safe drug memory-holed to protect lucrative Emergency Authorizations.
cards.power: Cleanse all debuffs. Opponents are mechanically required to mock you for using it.

cards.lore: Erasing a cheap, off-patent pill from reality to sell a shiny, billion-dollar new box.
cards.power: Delete a low-cost card from the game permanently to force the use of a high-cost card.

cards.lore: Selected for pre-existing biases, funded handsomely to squawk the preferred narrative.
cards.power: Repeat your last action for free, provided it directly benefits a Corporate player.

cards.lore: Continuing Medical Education operating as a synchronized, industry-funded marketing swarm.
cards.power: Force all players to move their pieces in the exact same direction this turn.

cards.lore: Astroturfing public demand by replacing normal human conditions with branded, treatable diseases.
cards.power: Replace an opponent's organic resource with a Disease token they must pay to cure.

cards.lore: The sole exhausted creature reading the microscopic conflict-of-interest disclosures.
cards.power: Spend 1 full turn reading the fine print to cancel an opponent's hidden trap.

cards.lore: Comparing the new drug to a placebo instead of the existing cure to guarantee a win.
cards.power: Rig the dice. Your next roll is mathematically guaranteed to succeed.

cards.lore: Healing patients while continuously dodging laser-guided regulatory missiles.
cards.power: Provide alternative healing to an ally, but roll a D6: on a 1, lose your medical license.

cards.lore: Vultures on a high bench dispensing dissolution, threats, and corporate protectionism.
cards.power: Strip an opponent of their ability to use any item cards for 2 full turns.

cards.lore: Locusts in suits migrating seamlessly between public regulation and private industry.
cards.power: Relocate your units instantly to any corporate or regulatory zone on the board.

cards.lore: A purgatorial cobweb chamber specifically designed to break your spirit and lower your standards.
cards.power: Force an opponent to completely skip their turn due to administrative delay.

cards.lore: A blur of motion scribbling scripts without making eye contact with the human being.
cards.power: Play a card blindly from your hand without reading it to save time.

cards.lore: Glossy billboards for miracle pills that are quietly pulled from the market two years later.
cards.power: Deal heavy damage to a foe, but take equal damage next turn as side effects hit.

cards.lore: The list of adverse events is mathematically longer than the description of the benefit.
cards.power: Attach to a buffed unit. It takes 1 damage per turn for every buff it currently has.

cards.lore: A single peanut on the scales of justice weighed against the GDP of a small nation.
cards.power: Break any rule, pay 1 coin in fines, and keep 100 coins in profit.

cards.lore: Cure is a dead end. Management is a smoothly paved, endless toll road.
cards.power: Convert a one-time healing bonus into a permanent, smaller, recurring income stream.

cards.lore: A golden stamp of approval operated by a crank turned by a bloated plutocrat.
cards.power: Make one of your cards entirely immune to all regulatory attacks or audits.

cards.lore: Concrete poured over glowing crystals. Nothing to see here, move along.
cards.power: Bury an opponent's most powerful card at the absolute bottom of the deck.

cards.lore: Tossing the corporate script into a warm, crackling analog campfire of defiance.
cards.power: Reject a mandatory corporate directive and regain 2 health points.

cards.lore: Liberating the locked clinical data from the basement mainframe to find the actual truth.
cards.power: Reveal all hidden cards on the board and immediately negate their traps.

cards.lore: A glowing zine radiating anti-establishment energy, repelling the corporate bats.
cards.power: Create a permanent safe zone where corporate powers have absolutely no effect.

cards.cardName: The System is Running on Time
cards.lore: A perfectly oiled machine chewing up sick animals and spitting out money.
cards.power: The game ends. The player with the most Corporate shares wins, everyone else loses.

title: Medicine Madness: The Waiting Room Anarchy
